flaggedFixed: visualizer: negative GDS PATH WIDTH (absolute width) collapsed to a 1-unit half width; now uses |w|/2

visualizer: cursor/drag NDC divided by a zero window extent when minimised
visualizer: diagonal path normals truncated instead of rounded; quarter-turn rotations now exact
